2610.08330.title: MoF: Preference-Aware Mixture Modeling for Black-Box LLM Personalization
2610.08330.paper_summary: Proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of tasks, yet aligning their outputs with diverse user preferences remains challenging. Existing personalization approaches for black-box LLMs often rely on user-specific scoring heads, causing the number of personalized parameters to grow linearly with the number of users and requiring additional adaptation for unseen users. To address these limitations, we propose Mixture-of-Facets (MoF), a scalable personalization framework for black-box LLMs that models user preferences as compositions of shared latent preference facets rather than dedicated user-specific parameters. MoF performs personalization through history-conditioned routing over shared facet heads, enabling personalization for users unseen during training without additional parameter updates. Across diverse personalization tasks, MoF delivers stronger personalization performance while maintaining a more scalable and parameter-efficient design than prior approaches. Additional analysis indicates strong generalization to unseen users.
2610.08330.paper_summary_zh: 專有的大型語言模型（LLMs）在各種任務中展現了卓越的能力，但使其輸出與不同用戶偏好對齊仍然具有挑戰性。現有的黑箱LLM個性化方法通常依賴於用戶特定的評分頭，導致個性化參數的數量隨著用戶數量線性增長，並且需要對未見過的用戶進行額外的適應。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了混合面向（Mixture-of-Facets, MoF），這是一個可擴展的黑箱LLM個性化框架，將用戶偏好建模為共享潛在偏好面向的組合，而不是專用的用戶特定參數。MoF通過對共享面向頭的歷史條件路由來執行個性化，使得對訓練期間未見過的用戶進行個性化成為可能，而無需額外的參數更新。在各種個性化任務中，MoF提供了更強的個性化性能，同時保持比以往方法更具可擴展性和參數效率的設計。額外的分析顯示對未見過的用戶具有強大的泛化能力。
2610.08330.author: Hun Park et.al.
